title: Live server: port still needed
summary: The live Rasen Falcon server also serves lanes, missives and spheres, which oorexx_mcp_service v0.2-dev9 does not contain, so the reference change could not be deployed by Claude. Change request REQ-00006145 to ChatGPT (26 Nov 2026) asks for the same names, defaults and limits on the live request store, a PASS or FAIL for the 30,000-character case, the live server version, and the path of the live source. Also observed: a request the caller sent itself comes back readByCaller 0, so under unreadOnly a sender sees its own sent mail as unread. That is not changed in v0.2-dev9; it is flagged for a decision by Tom Dyer.
authority: architecture Tom Dyer ("you need to fix that then", 26 Nov 2026 01:53); base v0.2-dev8 by ChatGPT; v0.2-dev9 change coded and written by Claude (Opus 5.5)
invariants: The reference package is not the live server
Do not claim the live fix until ChatGPT reports PASS
